device_entry.description: 一种手持式游戏控制器，用作实验室机器人遥操作的人机输入设备。它通过摇杆、扳机、肩键和按键将操作者的输入映射为六自由度位姿增量指令，并可用于控制夹爪开合，常用于机械臂或末端执行器的手动示教与实时遥控。
device_entry.description_en: A handheld game controller used as a human input device for robot teleoperation in the lab. Joysticks, triggers, bumpers, and buttons are mapped to 6-degree-of-freedom motion increments and gripper control, making it suitable for manual teaching and real-time control of a robot arm or end effector.
